title: KBC Bank to launch Bitcoin and Ether trading in Belgium under MiCA
summary: The lender will offer crypto trading through its Bolero platform as Belgium’s MiCA rules take effect, despite no licenses yet appearing on the ESMA’s register.

title: Interactive Brokers to allow stablecoins for account funding
summary: Electronic brokerage giant Interactive Brokers says its clients can deposit USDC, which will automatically convert to US dollars to fund their accounts.

title: US housebuilder to launch crypto rewards after SEC ‘no-action’ letter
summary: Megatel Homes says it’s launching a program where renters could receive rewards for paying their rent using a crypto token.

title: State Street rolls out new crypto tokenization tools
summary: State Street said its new crypto platform would help clients build tokenized money market funds, exchange-traded funds, and products such as tokenized deposits and stablecoins.

title: Crypto plumbing, policy improved in 2025, but prices ‘did not cooperate’: Binance
summary: Regulated investment vehicles such as exchange-traded funds expanded in 2025, and corporations added crypto to their balance sheets, opening up more pathways for user access.

title: Ethereum activity doubles with influx of new users: Glassnode
summary: Ethereum saw activity retention nearly double to 8 million addresses in a month while daily transactions hit an all-time high of 2.8 million amid soaring stablecoin use.

title: US college sports regulator calls for halt to prediction markets
summary: The NCAA wants the CFTC to tighten rules on college sport prediction markets, including age and advertising restrictions and anti-harassment measures.

title: Crypto sentiment drops amid unease over US market structure bill
summary: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index slipped by 12 points to “neutral” on Friday amid heightened anxiety over the future of a long-awaited crypto bill in the US.

title: DeadLock ransomware hides using exploited Polygon smart contracts
summary: Group-IB found a ransomware dubbed DeadLock that is exploiting Polygon smart contracts to rotate proxy addresses to evade takedowns.

title: Nexo to pay $500K fine to California regulator over ‘risky loans’
summary: California’s finance watchdog claims Nexo made nearly 5,500 loans to Californians without a valid license and did not properly assess their ability to repay.
